discordInvite.inviteBtn: Invite the bot to my Discord server
discordInvite.missingEnv: Environment variable DISCORD_CLIENT_ID is missing. Add your Discord Application ID (same as configured for the bot) to the site’s environment variables.
discordInvite.openTabHint: The link opens in a new tab to keep the dashboard here. After “Authorize”, if Discord shows “Success”, close that tab and return here.
discordInvite.oauthExtra: If OAuth redirect is configured, Discord may also open your dashboard in the new tab.
discordInvite.redirectSetup: For automatic redirect after authorization, set DISCORD_INSTALL_REDIRECT_URL or NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL to your dashboard’s public URL, and register the exact same URL under Discord → OAuth2 → Redirects.
discordInvite.step1: In the new tab, pick your server and approve permissions.
discordInvite.step2: On Discord, as administrator, run a bot slash command once (e.g. /setup channel) to register your guild.
discordInvite.step3: Refresh if needed: the server appears after the slash command.
discordInvite.more: Then configure the tactical channel from <link>Server</link>.

server.pageDesc: Announcement channel and default template — what your officers need day to day.
server.oauthBody: If your server still doesn’t appear, run a bot slash command (e.g. <cmd>/setup channel</cmd>) as a Discord administrator, then refresh this page.
server.emptySubtitle: Without a registered server, templates and events cannot target a channel.
server.emptyP1: The dashboard reads the <bold>same PostgreSQL database</bold> as the bot (same <mono>DATABASE_URL</mono> in your hosting). When the bot is online and has joined your server, the guild is saved — <bold>refresh this page</bold>. If the site and bot use different databases, the list stays empty.
server.emptyP2: If the server still doesn’t show: restart your bot deployment, or as <bold>Discord administrator</bold> run <mono>/setup channel</mono> (announcement channel) once, then refresh. Slash commands must be registered for your Discord application (per your deployment process).
server.emptyDevP1: Use the same <mono>DATABASE_URL</mono> in <mono>apps/web/.env.local</mono> and <mono>apps/bot/.env.local</mono> (e.g. Docker Postgres <mono>localhost:5433</mono>). Run <mono>npm run dev:stack</mono> or <mono>npm run bot:dev</mono> alongside the site, then re-invite or restart the bot after adding it to Discord.
server.emptyDevP2: Instant slash commands on a test guild: set <mono>DISCORD_DEV_GUILD_ID</mono> then <mono>npm run commands:register -w @kingshot/bot</mono>. See <mono>docs/DEVELOPPEMENT-LOCAL.md</mono>.
